activeTasksHint: Only activated tasks appear here. Activation is separate from task status; inactive tasks remain in Task planning.

workflows.planHelp: Paste a Manifest v1 JSON. Preview does not create tasks. Publishing adds new tasks only; it never rewrites existing work or Markdown.
workflows.reviewHelp: Review every task and dependency below. If workspace work changes after this preview, create a fresh preview before publishing.
workflows.recurrenceHelp: The server checks every minute, even when the app is closed. Past dates are marked missed; only today creates a task. Catch-up advances in batches of 366 calendar days. Paused rules and disabled accounts do not run. Monthly rules skip months without the start day.
